author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at work-in-progress gameplay from Exodus in this latest video for the upcoming sci-fi action-adventure RPG. The new Exodus video showcases stealth gameplay as you dive into a heavily guarded Celestial chamber held by Zealot forces. In Exodus, staying undetected puts you in control, letting you move through danger on your own terms. The clip shows Jun Aslan infiltrating hostile territory with companions Tom Vargas and Suliman, the use of Precognition to mark enemy positions before moving further in, disarming laser tripwire mines, close-quarters gauntlet takedowns, and the Recycler in the Spectre configuration: single-shot stealth mode for efficient eliminations.

Extended gameplay for Exodus will be revealed in summer 2026.

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

Exodus is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG where you become the Traveler—leading humanity’s fight for survival against the Celestials. Face our evolution 40,000 years in th
title: Exodus - Official Stealth in Action Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the reveal trailer for 4A Games much anticipated new entry in the post-apocalyptic world of Metro. Metro 2039. 

For 25 years, the last survivors of the nuclear war have been locked in a brutal conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow. Now, they've been united by a single fanatical Spartan leader known as Hunter. Hunter's regime is one of propaganda and fear, subjugating the population. Beyond the city, hidden in the wilderness, the Stranger is haunted by nightmares of his past. These nightmares force him out of exile and to journey to the one place he'd swore never to go. The Metro. 

Metro 2039 promises a single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat, stealth and horror, across a beautifully haunting world filled with threats. 

Metro 2039 releases this Winter for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Metro 2039 - Official Reveal Trailer

description:

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for It's Fine, an upcoming 2D idle clicker game that puts you in the shoes of a hard-working indie developer rushing to meet deadlines. It's Fine will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam. 

It finally happened. The Publisher moved your game’s release date, and you’re faced with the dreaded ‘game dev crunch’ and only 24 hours to ship Version 1.0. In It’s Fine, an active incremental clicker, players must manage their stations to release their anticipated indie on time.

With a dog for a project manager, a gorilla leading art direction, and a bot farm managing marketing, what could go wrong?
title: It's Fine - Official Demo Launch Trailer
